F_ALL_LEG_L1.description: "Territorial, ancient, furious to be caught. The king of the sea."
F_ALL_LEG_L1.name: Dragonfish
F_ALL_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ALL_LEG_M1.description: "Its tentacles that glitter like wisps of golden hair, but sting with the fire of thousand suns."
F_ALL_LEG_M1.name: Golden Jellyfish
F_ALL_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ALL_LEG_S1.description: "A voice like honey from a mouth of mucus."
F_ALL_LEG_S1.name: Singing Sea-Snail
F_ALL_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ALL_LEG_XL.description: "A true titan of the depths. Nothing compares for sheer mass."
F_ALL_LEG_XL.name: The Lunker
F_ALL_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_COLD_LEG_L1.description: "A heart that beats but once a hour, a heart that sees faster life spawn and die, spawn and die, spawn and die..."
F_COLD_LEG_L1.name: Iceblood Gulper
F_COLD_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_COLD_LEG_M1.description: "A name only spoken in whispers, its pale body a illusion that flickers beneath the moonlit waves."
F_COLD_LEG_M1.name: Ghostfin
F_COLD_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_COLD_LEG_S1.description: "A living snowflake: frozen solid yet still alive, its tentacles a fractal recursion."
F_COLD_LEG_S1.name: Crystal Jelly
F_COLD_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_COLD_LEG_XL.description: "None would believe the scale of this beast: its colossal shell, its enormous slimy foot. None, except those who have seen it..."
F_COLD_LEG_XL.name: Nautilia
F_COLD_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DEEP_LEG_L1.description: "Streamlined, deadly, perfect: the terror of the deep."
F_DEEP_LEG_L1.name: The Hunter Below
F_DEEP_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DEEP_LEG_M1.description: "It slides beneath the waves; it slides between the ears; it slides within the folds, and swims forever in your dreams."
F_DEEP_LEG_M1.name: Brain Eel
F_DEEP_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DEEP_LEG_S1.description: "Deep feeling swims in those watery eyestalks, the thoughtful intelligence of a true ancient."
F_DEEP_LEG_S1.name: Sentient Crab
F_DEEP_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DEEP_LEG_XL.description: "So young and fragile, despite its years beneath the waves. And yet thousands more years must pass before it joins the great herd in the stars..."
F_DEEP_LEG_XL.name: Leviathan Spawn
F_DEEP_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DUST_LEG_L1.description: "A relic of another age, a fusion of life and stone that refuses to die."
F_DUST_LEG_L1.name: Ossified Deinosuchus
F_DUST_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DUST_LEG_M1.description: "The many-mouths arise from the darkness of the ocean; the many-mouths hunger for their home in the sand..."
F_DUST_LEG_M1.name: Titanworm Larva
F_DUST_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DUST_LEG_S1.description: "A delicate creature, a fragment of the past that lives on in the water."
F_DUST_LEG_S1.name: Fragile Icthyoscale
F_DUST_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DUST_LEG_XL.description: "The apex of marine predation, a perfect killing machine. Beware."
F_DUST_LEG_XL.name: Megalodon
F_DUST_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_GAS_LEG_L1.description: "Both alive and not alive; at once a creature, a mineral, and a moment from another time..."
F_GAS_LEG_L1.name: Hyper-cockle
F_GAS_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_GAS_LEG_M1.description: "Brilliantly ablaze, its surface a perfect liquid sun..."
F_GAS_LEG_M1.name: Mother-of-Quicksilver
F_GAS_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_GAS_LEG_S1.description: "The geometry of its impossible body folds within itself, a writhing thread of flesh and spacetime."
F_GAS_LEG_S1.name: Mandelbrot Worm
F_GAS_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_GAS_LEG_XL.description: "So few things survive in waters such as these... so that which thrives should strike fear into the heart of any thinking being."
F_GAS_LEG_XL.name: The Maw of Titan
F_GAS_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_HOT_LEG_L1.description: "A dark cloud follows this creature, and dreams of doom await all those who touch it."
F_HOT_LEG_L1.name: Jelly of the Veil
F_HOT_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_HOT_LEG_M1.description: "Impossible to see with mortal eyes as it flashes through the water under boiling, cloudless skies."
F_HOT_LEG_M1.name: Mirrorscale Skipper
F_HOT_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_HOT_LEG_S1.description: "Its glittering shell is practically unbreakable, a material of pure perfection."
F_HOT_LEG_S1.name: Starshell Crab
F_HOT_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_HOT_LEG_XL.description: "Heart of stone and fins of iron, this creature lives on where all else falters."
F_HOT_LEG_XL.name: Ancient Irontail
F_HOT_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_LUSH_LEG_L1.description: "A powerful, muscular body and teeth like razors, these gentle giants protect smaller creatures from predators."
F_LUSH_LEG_L1.name: Reef Guardian
F_LUSH_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_LUSH_LEG_M1.description: "When hunting, can dissolve into a thin dark cloud, impossible to track, impossible to see coming..."
F_LUSH_LEG_M1.name: Mist Serpent
F_LUSH_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_LUSH_LEG_S1.description: "A creature of dreams, only visible where the light refracts through its soft, perfect jelly."
F_LUSH_LEG_S1.name: Glass Angel
F_LUSH_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_LUSH_LEG_XL.description: "The old man of the sea; scarred, blinded, still swimming on..."
F_LUSH_LEG_XL.name: Blind Titancore
F_LUSH_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ODD_LEG_L1.description: "Its song resonates across time and space, calling to its home in the endless black above. One day, it will rise and return to its home among the stars."
F_ODD_LEG_L1.name: Child of Helios
F_ODD_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ODD_LEG_M1.description: "Shell and claw of perfect crystal, eyestalks aglow with purple rage; a being displaced from another reality and cast here as crab."
F_ODD_LEG_M1.name: Atlantidian Crab
F_ODD_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ODD_LEG_S1.description: "Listen to these words: Do not allow this egg to hatch. Cast it back into the sea."
F_ODD_LEG_S1.name: Abyssal Horror Egg
F_ODD_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ODD_LEG_XL.description: "On the surface or below the waves, the vessel hungers, the vessel feeds..."
F_ODD_LEG_XL.name: Many-Mouthed Lunker
F_ODD_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_RAD_LEG_L1.description: "A pale blue glow surrounds it as it drifts through the water - a warning to all those who would come too close..."
F_RAD_LEG_L1.name: Gamma Squid
F_RAD_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_RAD_LEG_M1.description: "Its wings beat slowly as it sails though the poisoned seas, a drifter with no place of rest, no end to their journey."
F_RAD_LEG_M1.name: Aberrant Duskfin
F_RAD_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_RAD_LEG_S1.description: "A thousand eyes erupt from its soft flesh: a never-ending cycle of rising, blinking, sinking, and re-emergence."
F_RAD_LEG_S1.name: Many-Eyed Jellyfish
F_RAD_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_RAD_LEG_XL.description: "Polymorphic, twisting, always in motion; its body a constant whirr of shifting forms and ripping teeth."
F_RAD_LEG_XL.name: Helix Sawfish
F_RAD_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TOX_LEG_L1.description: "Robbed of flesh and stripped of colour by acid seas, the bonefish swims on regardless."
F_TOX_LEG_L1.name: Bleached Bonefish
F_TOX_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TOX_LEG_M1.description: "A true error of the deep; its hungry bite corrupts your blood, filling your body with a spurting corrosive bile."
F_TOX_LEG_M1.name: Vampire Squid
F_TOX_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TOX_LEG_S1.description: "Its perfect crystalline form glistens with a emerald light that changes the soul of all those whose eyes fall upon it."
F_TOX_LEG_S1.name: Emeril Sunstar
F_TOX_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TOX_LEG_XL.description: "Seemingly weak and fragile at the surface, these giant jaws have swallowed alive many an unwary soul who ventured into their abyssal home..."
F_TOX_LEG_XL.name: Translucent Gulper
F_TOX_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

MIND_ARC.name: Mind Ark

MIRROR.name: Solar Mirror

NANOTUBES.description: Metres and metres of high capacity carbon nanotubes.
NANOTUBES.name: Carbon Nanotubes

NIPNIPBUDS.name: NipNip Buds

OXYGEN.name: Oxygen

PIRATE_MAPPROD0.name: Pirate Map Fragment 1 of 3

PLANT_CAVE.name: Marrow Bulb
PLANT_CAVE.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_DUST.description: Succulent, edible cactus flesh from the Echinocactus plant. As well as being juicy on the tongue, the flesh has many industrial uses.
PLANT_DUST.name: Cactus Flesh
PLANT_DUST.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_HOT.description: A powerful chemical that has resisted attempts at synthesis. It can be harvested from the bark of the Solar Vine.
PLANT_HOT.name: Solanium
PLANT_HOT.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_LUSH.description: A beautiful gemstone, this prized product is the engorged, luminescent berry of the Star Bramble.
PLANT_LUSH.name: Star Bulb
PLANT_LUSH.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_POOP.description: A foul-smelling compound that can be harvested from the Gutrot Flower, or less desirably from the faecal matter of some species.
PLANT_POOP.name: Faecium
PLANT_POOP.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_RADIO.description: A strange substance that seems to slowly shift the air around it. It is found in the roots of the Gamma Weed plant.
PLANT_RADIO.name: Gamma Root
PLANT_RADIO.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_SNOW.description: A beautiful blue crystal, this organic compound possesses both great hardiness and a shimmering translucence. It is harvested from the leaves of Frostwort.
PLANT_SNOW.name: Frost Crystal
PLANT_SNOW.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_TOXIC.description: An oddly-glowing substance, harvested from the gills of Fungal Clusters.
PLANT_TOXIC.name: Fungal Mould
PLANT_TOXIC.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_WATER.description: A rubbery, luminescent sac harvested from underwater Candle Kelp plants.
PLANT_WATER.name: Kelp Sac
PLANT_WATER.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PORTAL_JUICE.description: The liquid's silvered surface forms a perfect mirror, your own face reflected back as you examine it. But the more you stare, the less perfect the mirror becomes. The face in the image moves. It blinks. It -
PORTAL_JUICE.name: Elixir of Quicksilver
PORTAL_JUICE.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction

POWERCELL.description: Convenient and optimised power storage unit. Used in a wide variety of defensive and hazard protection systems.
POWERCELL.name: Ion Battery
POWERCELL.subtitle: Portable Energy Storage

PURPLE2.description: A chromatic mineral, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.
PURPLE2.name: Quartzite
PURPLE2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Purple

PURPM_GAS_KEY.description: A ancient newborn star exists only at the strange intersection points of time and space, where the dissonance is strongest.
PURPM_GAS_KEY.name: Reality Anchor
PURPM_GAS_KEY.subtitle: Spacetime Tether

PURPM_LUSH_KEY.description: A ancient newborn star exists only at the strange intersection points of time and space, where the dissonance is strongest.
PURPM_LUSH_KEY.name: Reality Anchor
PURPM_LUSH_KEY.subtitle: Spacetime Tether

PURPM_MIRROR.description: To bridge between realities requires a scaffold and a seed.
PURPM_MIRROR.name: Anomalous Scaffold
PURPM_MIRROR.subtitle: Crystalline Breach

PURPM_PACKET.description: The howling of an advanced intelligence banished to oblivion, a reverberation in sentience and crystal.
PURPM_PACKET.name: Memories of Atlantid

REACTION1.name: Thermic Condensate
REACTION1.subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product

REACTION2.description: A refined product, taking ordinary carbon and boosting it with radioactive energy.
REACTION2.name: Enriched Carbon
REACTION2.subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product

REACTION3.description: A refined product, this is a powerful organic fertiliser in an easily distributed form.
REACTION3.name: Nitrogen Salt
REACTION3.subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product

RED2.description: A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.
RED2.name: Cadmium
RED2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Red

ROBOT1.description: This oily, unsettling liquid leaks from the circuitry of Sentinels.
ROBOT1.name: Pugneum
ROBOT1.subtitle: Anomalous Material

ROBOT2.description: This ethereal substance spills from the bodies of corrupted Sentinels as they fall, a shower of prismatic grains seeking out their next host. It evades all attempts to contain it, as if it had a will of its own, a strong desire for its own freedom.
ROBOT2.name: Atlantideum
ROBOT2.subtitle: Disharmonic Metal

ROCKETSUB.description: Radioactive isotope commonly used to fuel the fusion reactor at the heart of starship Pulse Engines.
ROCKETSUB.name: Tritium
ROCKETSUB.subtitle: Neutron-Rich Fuel Element

ROGUE_BEACON.description: A powerful but mellow musical instrument, capable of relaying song through space via gently undulating electromagnetic waves.
ROGUE_BEACON.name: Whalesong Flute
ROGUE_BEACON.subtitle: Cosmic Melody Instrument

ROGUE_CRAFTBOX.description: The shattered remnants of a previous existence. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres.
ROGUE_CRAFTBOX.name: Memory Fragment
ROGUE_CRAFTBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo

ROGUE_FINDER.description: A highly familar, entirely novel, piece of technology, designed by Specialist Polo as part of their loop research efforts. It synchronises its vibrations with the underlying song of the universe, allowing it to reveal memory hotspots within the loop.
ROGUE_FINDER.name: Memory Resonator
ROGUE_FINDER.subtitle: Loop Manifestation Technology

RUINSUB.description: The powdery remains of a highly polished mineral surface. It glitters as it catches the light, like fiery grains of sand.
RUINSUB.name: Polished Stone
RUINSUB.subtitle: Recycled Minerals

S10_ATLAS_SEED1.description: A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. This mere atom contains boundless noise, each tiny vibration the hopes and dreams of entire lifetimes.
S10_ATLAS_SEED1.name: Seed of Dreams
S10_ATLAS_SEED1.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas

S10_ATLAS_SEED2.description: A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. A particle of indescribable energy, it is unclear how to continues to exist within this reality.
S10_ATLAS_SEED2.name: Seed of Power
S10_ATLAS_SEED2.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas

S10_ATLAS_SEED3.description: A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. A flash of pure light and fury, this seed contains the unsuppressable need to exist.
S10_ATLAS_SEED3.name: Seed of Will
S10_ATLAS_SEED3.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas

S10_ATLAS_SEED4.description: A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. Though a mere speck, this seed contains the potential for an entire universe; a boundless, glorious expansion.
S10_ATLAS_SEED4.name: Seed of Life
S10_ATLAS_SEED4.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas

S10_ATLAS_SEED5.description: A seed of creation, a perfect droplet of infinity. A gift from the Atlas, this is a tiny fragment of all the universe's dreams, will, power and life; a fragment of the Travellers; a fragment of myself.
S10_ATLAS_SEED5.name: Seed of Hope
S10_ATLAS_SEED5.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas

S10_ROBO_ARMS.description: A set of complex hydraulic tubes and various gripping surfaces that form a pair of usable arms for a primitive automaton.
S10_ROBO_ARMS.name: Construct Limbs
S10_ROBO_ARMS.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component

S10_ROBO_BODY.description: The principal metallic carapace for a primitive automaton.
S10_ROBO_BODY.name: Construct Shell
S10_ROBO_BODY.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component

S10_ROBO_CORE.description: The central reactor unit and primary fuel source for a primitive automaton.
S10_ROBO_CORE.name: Atlantid Reactor
S10_ROBO_CORE.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component

S10_ROBO_HEAD.description: The circuit cage and primary control sensors for a primitive automaton.
S10_ROBO_HEAD.name: Construct Head
S10_ROBO_HEAD.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component

S10_ROBO_LEGS.description: A bipedal movement platform for a primitive automaton.
S10_ROBO_LEGS.name: Construct Legs
S10_ROBO_LEGS.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component

S10_SOUL.description: The Seed is an echo of life, the last reverberations of a living being.
S10_SOUL.name: Echo Seed
S10_SOUL.subtitle: Crystalline Sentience Cage

S12_POI_SEED1.description: This memory is a fragment of the cosmos, one filament in an infinite galaxy of possible pasts and possible futures.
S12_POI_SEED1.name: Memory of Ocean
S12_POI_SEED1.subtitle: Fragment of the Atlas

S12_POI_SEED2.description: This memory is a fragment of the cosmos, one filament in an infinite galaxy of possible pasts and possible futures.
S12_POI_SEED2.name: Memory of Conquest
S12_POI_SEED2.subtitle: Fragment of the Atlas

S12_POI_SEED3.description: This memory is a fragment of the cosmos, one filament in an infinite galaxy of possible pasts and possible futures.
S12_POI_SEED3.name: Memory of Bones
S12_POI_SEED3.subtitle: Fragment of the Atlas

S12_POI_SEED4.description: This memory is a fragment of the cosmos, one filament in an infinite galaxy of possible pasts and possible futures.
S12_POI_SEED4.name: Memory of the Void
S12_POI_SEED4.subtitle: Fragment of the Atlas

S15_FISH.description: Fire dances across the scales of this impossible marine being. Its starlit eyes stare back at you with a meaning far deeper than any fish should know. As they stare, the world around you fades away.
S15_FISH.name: The Angler
S15_FISH.subtitle: Legendary Fish

S19_TP.description: This device bypasses the mainstream teleport network, providing a direct link to the local Space Station.
S19_TP.name: Orbital Uplink
S19_TP.subtitle: Teleport Network Tunnel

S22_ECHO.description: The final sputtering flame of a Traveller soul.
S22_ECHO.name: Pilot Echo
S22_ECHO.subtitle: Unfragmented Traveller Essence

S22_FRAG_B.description: A ghostly fragment of Traveller soul, lingering where it no longer belongs.
S22_FRAG_B.name: Weaver Echo
S22_FRAG_B.subtitle: Lingering Soul Fragment

S22_FRAG_G.description: A ghostly fragment of Traveller soul, lingering where it no longer belongs.
S22_FRAG_G.name: Sage Echo
S22_FRAG_G.subtitle: Lingering Soul Fragment

S22_FRAG_R.description: A ghostly fragment of Traveller soul, lingering where it no longer belongs.
S22_FRAG_R.name: Royal Echo
S22_FRAG_R.subtitle: Lingering Soul Fragment

S22_SIGNATURE.description: The final sputtering flame of a Traveller soul, bound in the remains of living creatures.
S22_SIGNATURE.name: Pilot Signature
S22_SIGNATURE.subtitle: Unfragmented Traveller Identification

S23_BEACON.description: This beacon broadcasts a signal echo attuned to the historiographical flux mapped in the Space Anomaly databanks.
S23_BEACON.name: Myth Beacon
S23_BEACON.subtitle: Experimental Summoning Technology

S23_PROD.description: A seed from another place. It crackles and hisses with static.
S23_PROD.name: Like-Seed
S23_PROD.subtitle: Window to a Dream

S8_BEACON.description: A makeshift device, cobbled from salvaged electronic components kept in deep storage for many years. This jumble of wires will attempt to make contact with the last-known remnants of the freighter's homeworld.
S8_BEACON.name: Homeworld Repeater
S8_BEACON.subtitle: A Last Link Home

SAND1.description: An abundant mineral element, found within the geological strata of all rocky worlds. Easily extracted using a Terrain Manipulator. Create a tunnel anywhere to begin extraction.
SAND1.name: Silicate Powder
SAND1.subtitle: Abundant Mineral

SHIPBRAIN.description: The central processing unit of a Sentinel interceptor ship. The circuitry writhes microscopically, constantly rearranging itself as it scans for anomalies.
SHIPBRAIN.name: Hyaline Brain
SHIPBRAIN.subtitle: Sentience Vessel

SHIPCHARGE.description: A power storage unit optimised for use in starship defensive systems.
SHIPCHARGE.name: Starshield Battery
SHIPCHARGE.subtitle: Portable Energy Storage

SIGNALCHARGE.description: A high-powered battery pack, designed to release a significant charge in a short space of time.
SIGNALCHARGE.name: Surge Battery
SIGNALCHARGE.subtitle: High Voltage Energy Pack

SLIMEPOST1.description: Though apparently inorganic, the molecular makeup of these fibres has been drastically changed by exposure to both cosmic radiation and novel viral proteins.
SLIMEPOST1.name: Gelatinous Fibres
SLIMEPOST1.subtitle: Biometallic Strands

SOULFRAG.description: A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into the surface of a tiny metallic shard. This fragment of data represents a recording of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience.
SOULFRAG.name: Fragmented Qualia
SOULFRAG.subtitle: Soul Fragment

SPACEGUNK1.description: A pulsating, foul smelling goop that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery.
SPACEGUNK1.name: Residual Goop
SPACEGUNK1.subtitle: Junk

SPACEGUNK2.description: An out of control mould growth that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery.
SPACEGUNK2.name: Runaway Mould
SPACEGUNK2.subtitle: Junk

SPACEGUNK3.description: Handfuls of corroded metal, distorted by years of exposure to the harsh environment.
SPACEGUNK3.name: Rusted Metal
SPACEGUNK3.subtitle: Junk

SPACEGUNK4.description: A heavy, oozing slime. It is moving gently, as if it has a heartbeat of its own.
SPACEGUNK4.name: Living Slime
SPACEGUNK4.subtitle: Junk

SPACEGUNK5.description: An unnaturally thick liquid of dubious colour. Its origins are impossible to fathom.
SPACEGUNK5.name: Viscous Fluids
SPACEGUNK5.subtitle: Junk

SPECIAL_POOP.description: An odourless, mineral-rich substance with a hexagonal crystalline structure, harvested from the faecal matter of a creature.
SPECIAL_POOP.name: Hexite
SPECIAL_POOP.subtitle: Unrefined Organic Element

SPIDER_PROD.description: The functional core of a Sentinel quadruped unit, but warped beyond all recognition. The entire machine is infested with a crystalline material that pulses wildy upon inspection.
SPIDER_PROD.name: Crystallised Heart
SPIDER_PROD.subtitle: Corrupted Aeronic Core

SPOOK_JUICE.description: A slight membrane has begun to form over this viscous purple liquid. Beneath its glassy surface it swirls slowly, forming syrupy currents of its own accord.
SPOOK_JUICE.name: Elixir of Glass
SPOOK_JUICE.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction

SQUIDFRAG.description: A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into an ethereal shard of glass. This fragment of data represents a trace of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience.
SQUIDFRAG.name: Shattered Qualia
SQUIDFRAG.subtitle: Soul Fragment

STAFF_PART_A.description: A strap of flexible resin, securely wrapped around a steel pole.
STAFF_PART_A.name: Fibreglass Grip
STAFF_PART_A.subtitle: Voltaic Component

STAFF_PART_B.description: A compact box of circuitry and ethereal crystals, painstakingly wired by hand.
STAFF_PART_B.name: Atlantideum Chamber
STAFF_PART_B.subtitle: Voltaic Component

STAFF_PART_C.description: An electrified arrangement of mechanical wheels. Transforms stored energy into beams or propulsion, according to the specifications of weapons and laser attachments.
STAFF_PART_C.name: Concentric Transducer
STAFF_PART_C.subtitle: Voltaic Component

STELLAR2.description: A processed metal alloy, created in a Refiner from the stellar metals: Copper, Cadmium, Emeril and Indium.
STELLAR2.name: Chromatic Metal
STELLAR2.subtitle: Highly Refined Stellar Metal

STORM_CRYSTAL.description: A rare and highly valuable cluster of storm crystals. These crystalline structures thrive in stormy conditions, and naturally attract lightning strikes, becoming spectacularly luminescent when ionised. Exclusively found on extreme weather planets.
STORM_CRYSTAL.name: Storm Crystal
STORM_CRYSTAL.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity

SUBFUEL.description: A high thermal energy fuel, contained within a standardised fuel cell. Used to fuel the Humboldt Drive that powers the Nautilon submarine.
SUBFUEL.name: Hydrothermal Fuel Cell
SUBFUEL.subtitle: Submarine Reactor Fuel

SUNGOLD.description: Conventional planetary metal, superheated and then held in a stabilised plasmatic form.
SUNGOLD.name: Liquid Sun
SUNGOLD.subtitle: Transmuted Metal

SWARMDUST.description: When swarmer shells are completely obliterated, this syrupy metal remains. It has a cloying, coppery smell that clings to the throat.
SWARMDUST.name: Corrupted Ichor
SWARMDUST.subtitle: Corrosive Biofluid

TECHFRAG.description: A dense miasma of Nanites, undulating in its potentiality. These clusters are stable, but unrestricted nanite foam can produce undesirable runaway reactions in the presence of organic matter.
TECHFRAG.name: Nanite Cluster
TECHFRAG.subtitle: Technological Currency

TECH_COMP.description: A prefabricated circuit board, designed for flexible use in a large range of technology components.
TECH_COMP.name: Wiring Loom
TECH_COMP.subtitle: Universal Technology Platform

TIMEDUST.description: Grey, dead, sparkling with life and colour, singing as it shimmers. This impossibly fine dust is the accumulated decay of time and memories.
TIMEDUST.name: Somnal Dust
TIMEDUST.subtitle: Decayed Spacetime Remnant

TIMEMILK.description: The echo of a genetic possibility, forgotten by evolution. It twitches with a wild energy.
TIMEMILK.name: Ancestral Memories
TIMEMILK.subtitle: Recessive Creature Genes

TOXIC1.description: Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor.
TOXIC1.name: Ammonia
TOXIC1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

TRA_CURIO2.description: Edible product much beloved by the Gek.
TRA_CURIO2.name: GekNip
TRA_CURIO2.subtitle: Trade commodity

ULTRAPROD1.description: A highly advanced piece of technology for use in the next generation of power plants. Producing a fusion core requires both intricate scientific skills and complex industrial processes.
ULTRAPROD1.name: Fusion Ignitor
ULTRAPROD1.subtitle: Highly Refined Technology

ULTRAPROD2.description: A device specifically crafted to keep lifeforms alive for thousands of years longer than their natural lifespan. Such a device requires great skill to manufacture, as not only is it technically complex, but the consequences for a user in the event of malfunction would be disastrous.
ULTRAPROD2.name: Stasis Device
ULTRAPROD2.subtitle: Highly Refined Technology

VENTGEM.description: Formed in the incredible, high-pressure furnace of planetary cores, these rich mineral deposits have an almost glass-like quality.
VENTGEM.name: Crystal Sulphide
VENTGEM.subtitle: Compressed Mineral

WALKER_PROD.description: Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch.
WALKER_PROD.name: Walker Brain
WALKER_PROD.subtitle: Anomalous Material

WATER1.description: A naturally occuring salt, found in abundance in underwater minerals.
WATER1.name: Salt
WATER1.subtitle: Aquatic Mineral Extract

WATER2.description: A reactive element most easily harvested by processing the salt-infused minerals found in oceans.
WATER2.name: Chlorine
WATER2.subtitle: Processed Aquatic Mineral

WATERPLANT.description: A blue-green organic compound produced during the metabolic cycle of deep-sea plantlife. Rich in soluble energy, cyto-phosphates are crucial in many submarine technologies.
WATERPLANT.name: Cyto-Phosphate
WATERPLANT.subtitle: Organic Compound

WATERWORLD1.description: Local metallic extract, typically found in large deposits or harvested from common mineral formations after inspection with an Analysis Visor.
WATERWORLD1.name: Lithium
WATERWORLD1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

WHALE_BEACON.description: A signal receiver and amplifier, tuned to the wavelength of the unconscious mind. It is every colour all at once, splitting the surrounding light into a shimmering rainbow.
WHALE_BEACON.name: Dream Aerial
WHALE_BEACON.subtitle: Subconscious Access Device

WORMCORE.description: The coiled remains of a Hungering Tendril's digestive tract. Though its meaty walls still convulse, there is surely no way for a fresh tendril to regrow from these meagre scraps...
WORMCORE.name: Flesh Rope
WORMCORE.subtitle: Intestinal Fragment

WORMDUST.description: A powdery desert soil, slick with the gland expressions of a colossal sandworm. Historically, some have regarded this dust as the divine parent of such worms. It smells curiously sweet.
WORMDUST.name: Cursed Dust
WORMDUST.subtitle: Ashes of Despair

WORMPROD.description: The fragile embryo of a Hungering Tendril, still dripping with mucal butter. It wails and recoils when touched.
WORMPROD.name: Vile Spawn
WORMPROD.subtitle: Hungering Embryo

YELLOW2.description: A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.
YELLOW2.name: Copper
YELLOW2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Yellow
